alias: FLOWER: Auto-Reset MiFlora on Nodes 5a & 4 (Living Room)
description: Automatically restarts miflora.service on Nodes 5a and 4 if no flower sensor in Living Room groups (LV1, LV2, LV3) has provided readings for over 24 hours.

data.title: 🌸 Living Room Flower Sensors: Nodes 5a & 4 Reset
data.message: No readings received from Living Room flower sensors (LV1-LV3) for over 24 hours. Automatically restarted miflora.service on Nodes 5a and 4.

data.title: MiFlora Nodes 5a & 4 Reset
data.message: No readings from Living Room flower sensors for >24h. Automatically restarted miflora.service on Nodes 5a and 4.
